settings.question: What exactly is NMN?
settings.answer: NMN (β-Nicotinamide Mononucleotide) is a molecule your body uses as the direct precursor to NAD⁺ — a coenzyme essential for cellular energy and DNA repair. NAD⁺ declines with age; supplementing NMN is a researched way to support it.

settings.question: How much should I take?
settings.answer: Our serving is 2 capsules (1000 mg) once daily, ideally in the morning, with or without food. Consistency matters more than timing.

settings.question: When will I feel something?
settings.answer: NAD⁺ support is cumulative. Some notice steadier energy in 2–4 weeks; the cellular benefits compound over 60–90 days of daily use.†

settings.answer: Yes — every batch is tested by an ISO 17025-accredited lab for purity (≥99%), identity, heavy metals and microbials. Scan the QR on your bottle to see your lot's certificate.
